verdict.rationale: Lithic documents a single create-card endpoint that issues virtual cards (POST /cards), and a sandbox that mirrors production for running cards end-to-end, so the core one-call issuance is covered. The evidence never shows PAN, CVV, or expiry returned programmatically at issuance, and nothing shows a self-serve path from sandbox to live cards. missing for 10: evidence that PAN/CVV/expiry are returned in the create response, a documented self-serve sandbox-to-production path without a sales cycle, independent hands-on corroboration.
